title: Hash ids for every doc, shown by name
quote: Option (a), and migrate decisions and intents too.
means: The migration gives every doc a flat hash id, decisions and intents included, and every link and reference is stored as that id (D-53, D-69). What people see is a name: the apps and brain prime show a decision as D-n and an intent as AIP-n, numbered by avenMAIA, who alone writes them, so the numbers cannot clash; every other doc shows its title. Text stored with ids reads with names.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-75 that held
reflection.result: supersedes nothing; answers what D-45 left open (whether D-n and AIP-n stay as labels): they stay as the names shown
